newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish automotive output dives 23 pct in January.
newsitem.headline: Turkish automotive output dives 23 pct in January.

text.p: Turkey's motor vehicle output shrank to 21,046 units in January, down 23 percent from 27,292 in January 1996, the association of automotive industry (OSD) said on Friday.
Car output plunged 38 percent from a year ago to 12,136 in January due to weak demand, the OSD said in a statement.
"Car sales in January rose to 9,408, up 8.2 percent from 8,693 in January 1996, but this was purely due to the increase in imported car sales," the OSD said.

Domestic car sales dropped to 6,159, the lowest level recorded for January in the last five years while sales of imported cars surged 142 percent to 3,249 last month, bringing the share of imports in total car sales to 34.5 percent, up sharply from 15.4 in January 1996.
January output increased 56 percent from a year ago to 2,703 in trucks, 46 percent to 1,824 in pick-ups and 73 percent to 278 in buses, but fell 23 percent to 2,723 in farm tractors, the OSD said.
